newsitem.title: USA: SunAmerica annuity sales up 19 pct in Q2.
newsitem.headline: SunAmerica annuity sales up 19 pct in Q2.

text.p: SunAmerica Inc said total annuity sales rose 19 percent to $711 million in the second quarter and variable product sales rose 19 percent as well to $660 million.
SunAmerica chairman Eli Broad said the company has more than doubled its share of the variable annuity market over the past two years.

The company said sales of its flagship variable annuity product, Polaris, ranked fifth among all variable annuity products in the nation in the fourth calendar quarter of 1996, up from 25th just two years earlier.

"The continued growth of our variable annuity sales reflects the increasing awareness among consumers that variable annuities are among the best savings products available in today's retirement savings marketplace," he said.
Mutual fund sales rose 88 percent to $120 million in the second quarter and 82 percent to $182 million for the first half of 1997.
Guaranteed investment contract sales rose 144 percent to $692 million in the second quarter and rose 139 percent to $1.2 billion for the first half.
SunAmerica on Thursday reported operating earnings of $0.67 a share compared with the First Call consensus estimate of $0.64 a share.
